payload.answer: Cards are deprecated, it should be removed totally form the project. What are test selection, summaries used for? Maybe we need to revise what should be done on that end of turn plumb output topic? What is plumb supposed to do here? Make sure that tests are also removed when features are not necessary anymore. Poneytail should make sure of htat no?

options.description: The turn ends at once with the read-back; the test selection, cards and summary are computed in the background and reach you at your next message. Nothing is cut.
options.label: Not at all: background only (Recommended)

options.description: plumb may spend up to about 5 seconds inline; what does not fit moves to the background.
options.label: A few seconds

options.description: Up to 90 seconds stays allowed, with a progress bar in the band while it works.
options.label: Keep the long wait, show progress

payload.question: At the end of a turn plumb currently works for up to 90 seconds before you see its line, and on recent days every turn hit that limit. How long may plumb keep you waiting at a turn's end?
